blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Five Filipinos carry the Team Philippines’ medal hopes in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 weightlifting competition. The weightlifting tournament is scheduled from September 23 to September 29 at Nagoya City Trade and Industry Center. SOURCE: Asian Games official website. Information is subject to change.
